title: StackOps Secrets Catalog
description: Schema for named logins that contain one or more secret records.

$schema.description: Optional link to the JSON Schema used for this file.

entries.description: Named credential logins that contain one or more secrets.

rotation.description: Optional rotation metadata for a secret.

lastRotated.description: Date the secret was last rotated.

rotateEveryDays.description: Recommended maximum age before rotating this secret.

owner.description: Person or team responsible for rotating this secret.

login.description: A login, account, tenant, application, or service containing one or more secrets.

tags.description: Labels used to group or filter this login.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of this login and its purpose.

url.description: Relevant service, account, or secret management URL.

email.description: Email address associated with this login.

username.description: Username used to sign in to this account or service.

accountName.description: Optional account name used to distinguish logins with the same service.

secrets.description: Credential bundles belonging to this login. Each bundle has a name and keyValues containing its secret fields.

metadata.description: Additional login attributes stored as non-empty string keys and values.

secret.description: One logical secret bundle, such as an API key, token, password, or access key pair.

tags.description: Labels used to group or filter this secret.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of this credential bundle and its purpose.

scopes.description: Application scopes, permission scopes, or environments where the secret applies.

keyValues.description: Arbitrary JSON fields for this secret. The env-export CLI stringifies values when exporting.

rotation.description: Recorded rotation date, recommended rotation interval, and responsible owner.

metadata.description: Additional attributes for this credential bundle stored as non-empty string keys and values.
